121-131.title: Site-calibrated cloud response
121-131.hypothesis:
Test fixed site and site-cloud corrections learned entirely before the held week; this is same-site calibration, not unseen-site transfer.

Development feedback available before this hypothesis: [{"attempt": "attempt-001", "group_MAE": 26.08864484612999, "worst_group": 73.13606005052783}, {"attempt": "attempt-002", "group_MAE": 15.61728917004361, "worst_group": 41.406446157849885}, {"attempt": "attempt-003", "group_MAE": 16.519211218583234, "worst_group": 51.0549779280902}, {"attempt": "attempt-004", "group_MAE": 13.377591210624121, "worst_group": 39.739564319860925}]

This attempt tests a distinct explanation/ablation. All reserved groups remain unscored. A failure to beat the incumbent rejects predictive benefit rather than proving absence of the underlying physical process.

Decision rationale: Humidity-cloud interaction lowers error to13.38W/m² and worst-day error39.74. Test whether source-site calibration adds stable information rather than a universal radiative response.
